page.title: Mistfall Hunter: Dark Fantasy Extraction ARPG
page.meta_description: Mistfall Hunter is a dark fantasy third-person PvPvE extraction ARPG. See Steam release date, price, platforms, classes, and gameplay details.
page.tagline: Scavenge Gyldenblood, fight rival hunters, and reach a Returner Woodling before death strips your spoils.
overview: Mistfall Hunter is a third-person PvPvE extraction ARPG set in a dark fantasy world where the gods have fallen and the Gyldenmist is consuming the land. You are revived by a mysterious girl named Dew and sent to harvest Gyldenblood and mend the shattered Web of Fate. The Steam page lists Bellring Games as developer and Skystone Games as publisher.

The loop is high-stakes: scavenge Gyldenblood and forgotten relics, fight corroded creatures and rival Gyldhunters, then reach a Returner Woodling to extract. Death strips you of your spoils. You can hunt solo or in a three-player squad, and combat uses free-aim, combos, tactical items, and mid-battle weapon-stance swaps.

Six classes each have two weapon stances, with talent trees, rare gem affixes, and active skills for customization. Seasonal changes add new classes, arcana, zones, and relics. The store page states there are zero pay-to-win mechanics and no paid stat boosts. Steam lists a Jul 29, 2026 release date and a $19.99 price on Windows.

how_to_play: Choose one of six classes, then set your gear, talent tree, gem affixes, and active skills.
Drop into the mist solo or with a three-player squad.
Scavenge Gyldenblood and forgotten relics while fighting corroded creatures and rival Gyldhunters.
Use free-aim, combos, tactical items, and mid-battle stance swaps to win PvPvE encounters.
Fight your way to a Returner Woodling to extract with your loot; death strips you of your spoils.
tips: Use the precision free-aim system to target enemies' weak points.
Swap between your class's two weapon stances mid-battle to adapt to the encounter.
Deploy tactical items to outsmart rivals and survive split-second fights.
Treat extraction as the goal: reach a Returner Woodling before greed costs you the haul.
In a three-player squad, fight back-to-back to handle towering monstrosities and rival parties.
Build through talents, gem affixes, and active skills for assault, evasion, crowd control, or defense.
Expect seasonal shifts to change classes, arcana, zones, and relics.
